articles.title_en: The effect of workplace vs school-based vocational education on youth unemployment: Evidence from France
articles.title_cn: 工作场所与学校职业教育对青年失业的影响：来自法国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We conducted a field experiment in France which shows that employers exhibit little preference when deciding whom to invite for job interviews: unemployed apprentices or vocational students, both of whom have earned the same diploma. By merging the results of this experiment with a search and matching model which accounts for the selection of apprentices retained by their training firms, we provide a framework to understand the ways in which apprenticeship influences youth employment. Our results indicate that the main positive impact on employment comes from retaining apprentices within their training company, while the productivity gap compared to vocational students remains minimal when the same skills can be acquired through the academic path or apprenticeship.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在法国进行了一项实地实验，结果表明，雇主在决定邀请谁参加求职面试时几乎没有表现出偏好：失业的学徒或职业学校学生，两者都获得了相同的文凭。通过将这一实验结果与一个考虑培训企业保留学徒选择的搜索与匹配模型相结合，我们提供了一个框架来理解学徒制影响青年就业的方式。我们的结果表明，对就业的主要积极影响来自于将学徒保留在其培训公司内，而当相同技能可以通过学术路径或学徒制获得时，与职业学校学生相比的生产率差距仍然很小。

articles.title_en: COVID angels fighting daily demons? Mental well-being of healthcare workers and religiosity
articles.title_cn: 新冠天使对抗日常恶魔？医护人员的心理健康与宗教信仰
articles.abstract_en: Relying on a unique survey of more than 15,000 healthcare workers conducted from June to August 2020 in Italy, we show that religious priming caused participants to have a less dramatic recollection of their distressful experience during the first wave of COVID-19. Consistent with the view that religiosity serves as a coping mechanism, this effect was stronger for those who were more exposed to the virus categories during the first wave of the pandemic (e.g hospital workers) and for respondents who faced more stressful situations, such as being reassigned due to the COVID-19 emergency, or working in a COVID-19-related specialty (e.g, emergency care). All things being equal, the effect was found to be stronger among nurses, who indeed were identified as “COVID angels” during the intense media campaign of the first wave. We find no evidence that the results are sensitive to either the timing of the survey response or distance from the main events recollected.
articles.abstract_cn: 依托一项在意大利于2020年六月至八月进行的、涵盖超过15,000名医护人员的独特调查，我们表明宗教启动效应使参与者对第一波COVID-19疫情期间的痛苦经历回忆不那么戏剧化。与宗教信仰作为应对机制的观点一致，这种效应在那些第一波疫情期间更暴露于病毒类别的人群（如医院工作人员）以及面临更多压力情境的受访者（如因COVID-19紧急情况被重新分配岗位，或在COVID-19相关专科（如急救护理）工作）中更为显著。在其他条件相同的情况下，该效应在护士中更强，她们在第一波疫情期间的密集媒体宣传中确实被认定为“新冠天使”。我们没有发现证据表明结果对调查回应的时机或对所回忆主要事件的距离敏感。

articles.title_en: Bargaining with own-preference uncertainty: An experiment
articles.title_cn: 自有偏好不确定性下的讨价还价：一项实验
articles.abstract_en: While ‘standard’ theory argues that more information typically increases efficiency from exchange, the literature on fairness and bargaining suggests that information may inhibit agreements. However, the literature has typically focussed on information related to the payoffs of the other party. In many real-world interactions, a buyer is uncertain about their own value for a good they are purchasing. We consider a series of modified ultimatum games where we vary buyers’ certainty about their own values. We find that agreements increase when buyers discover their values. However, buyers potentially lose from this discovery if they are uncertain about sellers’ costs. Our results are driven by an increased aversion towards uncertainty when buyers are uncertain about both their own and the seller's payoff. This ‘twofold uncertainty effect’ cannot be rationalised by outcome-based other-regarding preferences and extends current understanding of the influence of uncertainty on perceptions of fair exchange.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然“标准”理论认为更多信息通常会提高交换效率，但关于公平和讨价还价的文献表明，信息可能阻碍协议达成。然而，文献通常关注与对方收益相关的信息。在许多现实世界的互动中，买方对自己所购商品的价值存在不确定性。我们考虑了一系列修改后的最后通牒博弈，其中我们改变买方对自己价值的确定性。我们发现，当买方发现自己的价值时，协议增加。然而，如果买方对卖方的成本不确定，他们可能因这种发现而受损。我们的结果是由当买方对自己和卖方的收益都不确定时，对不确定性的厌恶增强所驱动的。这种“双重不确定性效应”无法用基于结果的他者关怀偏好来解释，并扩展了当前对不确定性影响公平交换感知的理解。

articles.title_en: Costly voting in weighted committees: The case of moral costs
articles.title_cn: 加权委员会中的高成本投票：道德成本的情形
articles.abstract_en: We develop a theoretical model of voting behavior in committees when members differ in influence and receive payoffs that condition on the individual vote and the collective decision. Applied to a group decision involving moral costs, the model predicts that the distribution of decision-making power affects committee members’ incentives to make immoral choices: More influential agents tend to support the immoral choice, while less influential agents free-ride. A skewed power distribution makes immoral collective choices more likely. We then present results of a laboratory experiment that studies committee members’ voting behavior and collective choices under different distributions of decision-making power. As hypothesized, we find that the frequency of immoral decisions is positively related to an agent’s voting power.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个理论模型，研究当委员会成员影响力不同且其收益取决于个人投票和集体决策时的投票行为。将该模型应用于涉及道德成本的群体决策，模型预测决策权力的分配会影响委员会成员做出不道德选择的激励：更有影响力的成员倾向于支持不道德的选择，而影响力较小的成员则搭便车。权力分配的不均衡使得不道德的集体选择更可能发生。随后，我们展示了一项实验室实验的结果，该实验研究了在不同决策权力分配下委员会成员的投票行为和集体选择。与假设一致，我们发现不道德决策的频率与个体的投票权力正相关。

articles.title_en: Following beliefs or excluding the worst? The role of unfindable state in learning
articles.title_cn: 遵循信念还是排除最差？不可发现状态在学习中的作用
articles.abstract_en: An agent learns in continuous time from two information sources, each associated with a hypothesis. If a hypothesis is true, the associated source confirms it at a positive rate. False hypotheses are never confirmed. Among the two hypotheses, either exactly one is true or both are false. The agent’s optimal learning strategy has two phases. During the first phase, the agent follows his beliefs; that is, at each moment, he learns from the source associated with the most likely hypothesis according to his current beliefs. During the second phase, he focuses on excluding the least likely but more important hypothesis.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个代理在连续时间内从两个信息源学习，每个信息源与一个假设相关联。如果一个假设为真，相关源以正速率确认它。错误的假设永远不会被确认。在这两个假设中，要么恰好一个为真，要么两者都为假。代理的最优学习策略有两个阶段。在第一阶段，代理遵循他的信念；也就是说，在每个时刻，他从与根据他当前信念最可能的假设相关联的源学习。在第二阶段，他专注于排除最不可能但更重要的假设。

articles.title_en: Lives versus livelihoods in the middle ages: The impact of the plague on trade over 400 years
articles.title_cn: 中世纪的生命与生计：瘟疫对贸易长达400年的影响
articles.abstract_en: To what extent did outbreaks of bubonic plague disrupt trade? We estimate the impact of epidemics on trade between regional wheat markets over four centuries — from the Black Death in the 14th century, until the medieval form of the plague became extinct in the 17th century. Using a gravity model, we find that outbreaks had a statistically significant, but relatively modest, impact on local variations in wheat prices. The results provide quantitative evidence on the extent to which epidemics disrupted markets and trade in pre-industrial Europe.
articles.abstract_cn: 鼠疫爆发在多大程度上扰乱了贸易？我们估计了四个世纪以来——从14世纪的黑死病，直到17世纪中世纪形式的瘟疫灭绝——流行病对区域小麦市场之间贸易的影响。使用引力模型，我们发现疫情对小麦价格的局部变动产生了统计上显著但相对温和的影响。这些结果为流行病在多大程度上扰乱了前工业化欧洲的市场和贸易提供了定量证据。

articles.abstract_en: We formally study two bidder first-price, second-price, and all-pay auctions with known values, deriving the equilibrium payoffs and strategies and showing when all three yield the same equilibrium payoffs to the bidders. This latter result, the tripartite auction theorem, does not hold for all auctions, in particular it can fail for symmetric auctions with high stakes and in auctions with very low stakes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们正式研究具有已知价值的两位投标人的第一价格、第二价格和全支付拍卖，推导出均衡收益和策略，并展示这三种拍卖何时给投标人带来相同的均衡收益。后一个结果，即三方拍卖定理，并非对所有拍卖都成立，特别是对于高 stakes 的对称拍卖和极低 stakes 的拍卖，它可能不成立。

articles.title_en: Historical pathogen prevalence and the radius of trust
articles.title_cn: 历史病原体流行与信任半径
articles.abstract_en: Why do people exhibit different levels of trust between strangers and those who are socially close to them? This study tests the hypothesis that societies with a historical prevalence of infectious diseases develop strategies to minimise contact with potentially unhealthy or contaminated out-groups, while emphasising strong local networks of in-groups to manage infections effectively, ultimately leading to a lower radius of trust. Our empirical analysis verifies that societies with higher historical pathogen prevalence trust less out-groups relatively to in-groups using (i) cross-country; (ii) cross-country individual-level; (iii) ethnic group-level; and (iv) individual-level data for a sample of second-generation migrants. In particular, our findings support a negative association between historical pathogen prevalence and the contemporary radius of trust, specifically when we differentiate attitudes between socially distant groups (e.g., people met for the first time) and family members. Furthermore, this pattern remains consistent when we proxy trust attitudes using historical data on disapproval of violence at the ethnic group level from the Standard Cross-Cultural Sample. We find that an increase in historical pathogen prevalence is associated with a lower disapproval of violence toward out-group members from other societies relative to in-group members from the local community. Overall, historical pathogen prevalence sheds light on a fundamental cultural trait that persists over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么人们对陌生人与社会亲近之人表现出不同程度的信任？本研究检验了一个假设，即历史上传染病流行的社会会发展出策略，以最小化与潜在不健康或受污染的外群体的接触，同时强调强大的本地内群体网络以有效管理感染，最终导致较低的信任半径。我们的实证分析验证了历史病原体流行程度较高的社会对外群体的信任相对低于对内群体，使用了（i）跨国；（ii）跨国个体层面；（iii）族群层面；以及（iv）第二代移民样本的个体层面数据。特别是，我们的发现支持历史病原体流行与当代信任半径之间的负相关，尤其是当我们区分对社会距离较远的群体（如初次见面的人）与家庭成员的态度时。此外，当我们使用标准跨文化样本中族群层面关于对暴力不赞成的历史数据来代理信任态度时，这一模式保持一致。我们发现，历史病原体流行程度的增加与对外群体成员（来自其他社会）暴力不赞成程度的降低相关，相对于对内群体成员（来自本地社区）。总体而言，历史病原体流行揭示了一种随时间持续存在的基本文化特征。

articles.title_en: Cooperation and norm enforcement differ strongly across adult generations
articles.title_cn: 合作与规范执行在不同成年世代间存在显著差异
articles.abstract_en: Cooperation of different generations is crucial to meet many important societal challenges, including climate change or the sustainability of the welfare state. Little is known, however, about different generations’ ability to cooperate in social dilemma situations, and their willingness to enforce social norms of cooperation. We present an experiment with two generations – juniors in their 20ies, and seniors who are 50 years or older, with an average age of 67. They play a repeated prisoner's dilemma (PD) game with third-party punishment. The third party is either a person from the same generation as the players in the PD game or from the other generation, and this is common knowledge. We find that seniors cooperate twice as much as juniors do, irrespective of the generation of the third-party. Moreover, seniors are much stricter as third parties and punish norm violations much more frequently than juniors do. However, the cooperation levels of both generations react hardly to third party punishment, which means that both generations differ strongly in their attempts to enforce norms of cooperation and in their reaction to norm enforcement. These differences across generations may pose a serious threat for the solution of intergenerational problems.
articles.abstract_cn: 不同世代的合作对于应对许多重要的社会挑战至关重要，包括气候变化或福利国家的可持续性。然而，关于不同世代在社会困境情境中的合作能力及其执行合作社会规范的意愿，我们知之甚少。我们进行了一项实验，涉及两个世代——二十多岁的年轻人和年龄为50岁或以上、平均年龄为67岁的老年人。他们参与一个带有第三方惩罚的重复囚徒困境（PD）游戏。第三方要么是与PD游戏玩家同世代的人，要么是来自另一世代的人，且这是共同知识。我们发现，无论第三方属于哪个世代，老年人的合作程度是年轻人的两倍。此外，作为第三方，老年人更为严格，比年轻人更频繁地惩罚违规行为。然而，两个世代的合作水平对第三方惩罚几乎没有反应，这意味着两个世代在尝试执行合作规范及其对规范执行的反应上存在显著差异。这些世代间的差异可能对解决代际问题构成严重威胁。

articles.title_en: The normative permissiveness of political partyism
articles.title_cn: 政党主义的规范性容许度
articles.abstract_en: Political party identity has become one of the strongest social divides within many Western societies. This paper employs experiments to measure discrimination along different dimensions of social identity, and replicates previous findings showing the strongest discrimination against out-groups occurs in the political party domain. Moreover, we explore a possible explanation for this phenomenon based on social norms. We measure the social appropriateness of discrimination along each identity dimension. The ranking of dimensions by discrimination against out-groups reflects the extent to which such behaviour is normatively permissible, with the weakest anti-discrimination norms on the political party dimension. Results are qualitatively similar in two European countries. We argue that, while strong norms sanctioning discrimination on other dimensions have developed historically, no such process has taken place concerning party affiliation, bringing partisan identity to the fore and helping polarisation flourish.
articles.abstract_cn: 政党身份已成为许多西方社会中最强烈的社会分裂之一。本文通过实验衡量不同社会身份维度上的歧视，并重复了先前的研究发现，即对外群体的最强烈歧视发生在政党领域。此外，我们基于社会规范探讨了这一现象的一种可能解释。我们衡量了每个身份维度上歧视的社会适当性。各维度按对外群体歧视程度的排序反映了这种行为在规范上的容许程度，其中政党维度的反歧视规范最弱。在两个欧洲国家中，结果在性质上相似。我们认为，虽然历史上已经形成了制裁其他维度歧视的强规范，但关于党派归属却没有发生类似过程，这使得党派身份凸显，并助长了极化的发展。

articles.title_cn: 工人流动性与失业保险延长
articles.abstract_en: We develop an equilibrium search model with a labor force participation decision, job-to-job transitions, and endogenous separations. The calibrated model perfectly matches the observed labor market flows in US data. We use the model to simulate the effects of an extension of unemployment insurance benefits to 99 weeks. The reform leads to a decrease in employment, an increase in the labor force participation and unemployment rate, while it leaves labor productivity roughly constant. Using a model-based decomposition, as well as comparisons with alternative simplified models, we show that modeling workers’ participation decisions, job-to-job transitions, and endogenous separations together is crucial for a complete and accurate analysis of UI reforms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含劳动力参与决策、工作间转换和内源性离职的均衡搜索模型。校准后的模型完美匹配了美国数据中观察到的劳动力市场流动。我们利用该模型模拟了失业保险福利延长至99周的影响。改革导致就业减少，劳动力参与率和失业率上升，而劳动生产率大致保持不变。通过基于模型的分解以及与替代简化模型的比较，我们表明，将工人的参与决策、工作间转换和内源性离职共同建模对于全面准确地分析失业保险改革至关重要。

articles.title_en: The effects of free trade agreements on product-level trade
articles.title_cn: 自由贸易协定对产品层面贸易的影响
articles.abstract_en: We use highly disaggregated trade data to test whether “least traded products”–products either not traded previously or only traded in small amounts–experience faster trade growth after the signing of trade agreements and whether this is important for the aggregate trade creation effects of trade agreements. Because we use PPML, an estimator with unique aggregation properties, our product-level estimates are comparable to estimates based on aggregate trade data that are meant to capture aggregate trade creation effects. Using this approach, we find that virtually all of the trade creation associated with trade agreements comes from least traded products. Interestingly, for products that are very highly traded, we find that trade actually declines following an agreement. These results are robust to controlling for general mean reversion effects in the product-level trade data, which we also find evidence for, as well as for differences in observed tariff levels.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用高度细分的贸易数据来检验“最少交易产品”——即先前未交易或仅以少量交易的產品——在签署贸易协定后是否经历更快的贸易增长，以及这对贸易协定的总体贸易创造效应是否重要。由于我们使用PPML，一种具有独特聚合性质的估计器，我们的产品层面估计与基于总体贸易数据旨在捕捉总体贸易创造效应的估计具有可比性。使用这种方法，我们发现几乎所有与贸易协定相关的贸易创造都来自最少交易产品。有趣的是，对于交易量非常大的产品，我们发现贸易在协定后实际上有所下降。这些结果在控制产品层面贸易数据中的一般均值回归效应（我们也发现了其证据）以及观察到的关税水平差异后依然稳健。

articles.abstract_en: In the early phase of the COVID-19 crisis, China imposed widespread lockdowns to contain the virus. We study the spillovers from the lockdowns to the US economy. We find that sectors with a high exposure to intermediate goods imports from China experienced significantly larger declines in production, employment, imports, and exports. In addition, relative input and output prices increased in these sectors. At the peak of the recession in April 2020, output was 16% lower in sectors with a one standard deviation higher China exposure. The estimated effects on output, input, and inflation are short-lived and dissipate by summer 2020.
articles.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19危机的早期阶段，中国实施了广泛的封锁以控制病毒。我们研究了封锁对美国经济的溢出效应。我们发现，对中国中间品进口敞口较高的行业，其生产、就业、进口和出口的下降幅度显著更大。此外，这些行业的相对投入品和产出品价格也有所上涨。在衰退高峰期（2020年四月），中国敞口每高一个标准差，产出低16%。对产出、投入和通胀的估计影响是短暂的，并在2020年夏季消退。

articles.title_en: Does education prevent job loss during downturns? Evidence from exogenous school assignments and COVID-19 in Barbados
articles.title_cn: 教育能否在经济衰退期间防止失业？来自巴巴多斯外生学校分配和COVID-19的证据
articles.abstract_en: Canonical human capital theories posit that education, by enhancing worker skills, reduces the likelihood that a worker will be laid-off during times of economic change. Yet, this has not been demonstrated causally. We link administrative education records from 1987 through 2002 to nationally representative surveys conducted before and after the COVID-19 onset in Barbados to explore the causal impact of improved education on job loss during this period. Using a regression discontinuity design, we show that females (but not males) who score just above the admission threshold for more selective secondary schools attain more years of education than those who scored just below (essentially holding initial ability fixed). We then find that these same females are much less likely to have lost a job after the onset of COVID-19. We show that these effects are not driven by labor supply decisions, selection into more resilient sectors and occupations, the ability to telework, job seniority, health status, fertility or access to child care, or improved social networks. Because employers observe incumbent worker productivity, these patterns are inconsistent with pure education signaling and suggest that education enhances worker skill.
articles.abstract_cn: 经典人力资本理论认为，教育通过提高工人技能，降低了工人在经济变革时期被解雇的可能性。然而，这一点尚未得到因果性证明。我们将1987年至2002年的行政教育记录与巴巴多斯COVID-19爆发前后进行的全国代表性调查联系起来，探讨教育改善对这一时期失业的因果影响。利用断点回归设计，我们表明，在更具选择性的中学入学门槛附近得分略高的女性（而非男性）比得分略低的女性获得了更多年的教育（基本上保持初始能力不变）。然后我们发现，这些相同的女性在COVID-19爆发后失业的可能性要小得多。我们表明，这些效应并非由劳动力供给决策、进入更具韧性的部门和职业、远程工作能力、工作资历、健康状况、生育或托儿服务获取，或社交网络改善所驱动。由于雇主观察到在职工人的生产力，这些模式与纯粹的教育信号传递不一致，并表明教育增强了工人技能。

articles.title_en: Uncertainty shocks, financial frictions, and business cycle asymmetries across countries
articles.title_cn: 不确定性冲击、金融摩擦与跨国商业周期不对称性
articles.abstract_en: I show that uncertainty shocks trigger sharper declines in consumption, investment, and GDP – and a sharper increase in trade balances – in emerging countries relative to advanced countries during recessions. Using an open-economy model – estimated on a set of advanced and emerging countries – I demonstrate that these facts can be explained by an interaction between uncertainty and financial frictions. In particular, the results imply that during recessions, elevated borrowing costs in emerging countries – about 5.9% greater than advanced countries – interact nonlinearly with uncertainty to generate the observed excess volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 我表明，不确定性冲击在经济衰退期间会引发新兴国家相对于发达国家更急剧的消费、投资和GDP下降，以及贸易余额更大幅度的增加。利用一个开放经济模型——基于一组发达国家和新兴国家进行估计——我证明这些事实可以通过不确定性与金融摩擦之间的相互作用来解释。特别是，结果表明，在经济衰退期间，新兴国家较高的借贷成本——比发达国家高出约5.9%——与不确定性非线性相互作用，从而产生观察到的过度波动。

articles.title_en: Trick or treat? The Brexit effect on immigrants’ mental health in the United Kingdom
articles.title_cn: 不给糖就捣蛋？英国脱欧对英国移民心理健康的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates changes in the mental health of immigrants living in the United Kingdom (UK) during the European Union (EU) referendum. Using the UK Household Longitudinal Study, this paper assesses how the mental health of immigrants has changed before and after the referendum, compared to natives. Findings suggest that following the EU referendum result, mental health significantly improved overall for naturalised immigrants as a whole and for non-EU immigrants, relative to the changes in natives. Further, there is no evidence that mental health worsened even for EU immigrants. Our results vary by gender, with non-EU women experiencing a statistically significant improvement in mental health. The results are robust to several checks, including using balanced panel data and individual fixed effects. Our findings are consistent with the idea that the end of free movement for EU immigrants has alleviated the perception of discrimination against non-EU immigrants. This interpretation is supported by empirical results from a multinomial logit showing that non-EU migrants, particularly women, are more likely to perceive discrimination for race-related reasons when denied a job, an effect which is no longer significant in the post-referendum period.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了欧盟公投期间居住在英国（UK）的移民心理健康的变化。利用英国家庭纵向研究数据，本文评估了与本地人相比，移民在公投前后的心理健康如何变化。研究发现，在欧盟公投结果公布后，相对于本地人的变化，整体上入籍移民以及非欧盟移民的心理健康显著改善。此外，没有证据表明即使是欧盟移民的心理健康也有所恶化。我们的结果因性别而异，非欧盟女性在心理健康方面经历了统计上显著的改善。结果对多种检验具有稳健性，包括使用平衡面板数据和个体固定效应。我们的发现与欧盟移民自由流动的结束缓解了对非欧盟移民歧视感知的观点一致。这一解释得到了多项逻辑回归实证结果的支持，该结果显示非欧盟移民，尤其是女性，在求职被拒时更可能感知到与种族相关的歧视，而这种效应在公投后时期不再显著。
